# Story 26.1: Red-phase tests for review-story.md standards integration

Status: ready-for-dev

## Story

As a developer,
I want red-phase unit tests asserting that `.github/instructions/review-story.md` contains the integrated review-standards content — a reference to `code-review.md`, the severity taxonomy (Critical/Important), and condensed checklists covering security, testing, architecture, documentation, and the epics-2026-11-13 quality aspects —
so that Story 26.2 has a defined, executable contract to make pass and the consolidation is locked in against future drift.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. A unit test reads `.github/instructions/review-story.md` from disk (resolved relative to repo root) and asserts it references `code-review.md`.
2. A unit test asserts `review-story.md` defines a severity scale naming both **Critical** and **Important** levels (the code-review.md taxonomy).
3. A unit test asserts `review-story.md` contains a standards section covering at least the security, testing, architecture/design, and documentation checklists.
4. A unit test asserts `review-story.md` names the epics-2026-11-13 review aspects — architectural alignment (to spine ADs), domain modeling consistency, error-handling uniformity, data integrity, security posture, test coverage depth, dependency hygiene, and documentation freshness.
5. All tests are marked `.skip()` in code (`it.skip`) so the server Vitest suite runs green BEFORE Story 26.2 exists — red-phase by skip, not by failure. All pre-existing tests remain unskipped and green.

## Tasks / Subtasks

- [ ] Task 1 (AC: #1–#4): Add red-phase assertions for the standards content.
  - [ ] 1.1 Create `apps/server/src/app/review-story-standards.spec.ts` that reads `.github/instructions/review-story.md` from disk via a repo-root-relative path (`path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../..', '.github/instructions/review-story.md')`).
  - [ ] 1.2 Assert the file references `code-review.md`. Mark `it.skip`.
  - [ ] 1.3 Assert it names both **Critical** and **Important** severity levels. Mark `it.skip`.
  - [ ] 1.4 Assert a standards section covers security, testing, architecture/design, and documentation checklists (case-insensitive keyword match per checklist). Mark `it.skip`.
  - [ ] 1.5 Assert it names the epics-2026-11-13 aspects: architectural alignment, domain modeling, error handling, data integrity, security posture, test coverage, dependency hygiene, documentation freshness (case-insensitive keyword match per aspect). Mark `it.skip`.
- [ ] Task 2 (AC: #5): Confirm green with skips.
  - [ ] 2.1 Run `nx test server` and confirm fully green with only the new red-phase assertions skipped. Do NOT weaken or delete any assertion to achieve this — skip markers only.

## Dev Notes

- **Why:** The Darkfactory story-review gate (`.github/instructions/review-story.md`) currently judges findings by ad-hoc judgment across its three review layers, without carrying the quality standards established by `.github/instructions/code-review.md` or the extensive `epics-2026-11-13.md` code review. This story locks in a contract that those standards are integrated before Story 26.2 performs the edit.
- **Red-phase TDD:** this story is ordered before Story 26.2. Assertions are marked `it.skip` so CI stays green while `review-story.md` still lacks the standards section; Story 26.2's first task removes the skip markers, confirms red, then edits `review-story.md` until green.
- **Do NOT modify `.github/instructions/review-story.md` in this story** — test scaffold only. The documentation edit belongs to Story 26.2.
- **Test location:** a plain file-read assertion (no Angular/DOM) belongs in the server project's node-environment Vitest suite (`nx test server`) — same convention as `apps/server/src/app/routes/naming-and-import-order.spec.ts` (Story 24.1). The root vitest workspace runs only `server` + `electron`; dms-material is a separate Angular target and not the right home for this check.
- **Assertion style:** keyword/substring matches (case-insensitive) are sufficient — the goal is to lock in that the standards content *exists* in the instruction file, not to parse its exact wording. Keep each assertion independent so Story 26.2 can satisfy them incrementally if needed.

### Project Structure Notes

- Create: `apps/server/src/app/review-story-standards.spec.ts` (red-phase file-read assertions, all tests skipped).
- No changes to `.github/instructions/review-story.md` or any production code in this story.
